Maxing out hotels on Oriental, Vermont, and Connecticut would cost about $750 in houses but push rents up to $550-600 each, which seems worth pursuing.

I'll start by building 4 houses on each of the three light blue properties this turn, saving the hotel conversion for later, and hold off on the dark blues since unmortgaging Park Place plus full hotel builds there would run too expensive right now.
